s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of headache and vision loss with sinus inflammation
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Developed rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Recovered from COVID-19 but developed worsening headache
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Severe pain on ocular motion
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone on CT
Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus
Elevated Serum IgG4 levels
Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells on pathology

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of headache and vision loss with sinus inflammation
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Developed rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Recovered from COVID-19 but developed worsening headache
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Severe pain on ocular motion
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone on CT
Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus
Elevated Serum IgG4 levels
Dense infiltrate of IgG-containing plasma cells on pathology

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of headache, vision loss, and severe pain on ocular motion, combined with imaging findings of opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation and bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone, are consistent with sinusitis. The positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus and elevated Serum IgG4 levels further support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: glaucoma
rejected.why: While glaucoma can cause vision loss and eye pain, it does not typically cause opacification of sinuses or bony erosion.

rejected.label: central retinal artery occlusion
rejected.why: This condition can cause sudden vision loss, but it does not typically cause headache or sinus opacification.

rejected.label: pituitary apoplexy
rejected.why: This condition can cause sudden headache and vision loss, but it does not typically cause sinus opacification or bony erosion.

rejected.label: cerebral mucormycosis
rejected.why: While this condition can cause sinusitis and vision loss, it is typically seen in immunocompromised patients and the patient's recent diagnosis of COVID-19 and recovery do not suggest immunocompromise.
